editorial_notes: CN is primary for meaning; EN confirms names and ordinal alignment. Both contain 70 named dialogue lines at identical source line positions and identical non-dialogue instructions.
CN #8 explicitly says Mephisto could have saved many people; not necessarily Skullshatterer. RU preserves plural.
CN #32 specifies the Reunion rearguard (殿后的整合运动) rather than all people present; RU preserves the rearguard.
CN #46 says Misha would abandon Reunion fighters to their fate (自生自灭). EN reframes it as watching friends sacrifice themselves; RU follows CN.
CN #49 is a dash (——), whereas EN has ellipsis; RU keeps dash.

CN #68–70 is an unfinished three-part thought: 'Skullshatterer's… / … / I must…'. EN turns it into a complete claim about his legacy. RU follows CN and preserves the interrupted phrasing, without inventing a final object.
Commands [HEADER], [Background], [Character], [PlayMusic], [Delay], [Dialog], [Blocker], [Image] are unchanged by translation data; no complete CN/EN scripts redistributed.
This is a full first draft of 70 named lines, not an installed or client-verified patch.
